MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Chinese word means "is at, is in"? (1 mark)
   A. 在 zài
   B. 桌子 zhuōzi
   C. 床 chuáng
   D. 房子 fángzi

2. Which word is pronounced wòshì? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室
   B. 门
   C. 床
   D. 里

3. Which sentence means "The fridge is in the kitchen."? (1 mark)
   A. 浴室在花园旁边。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 沙发在门旁边。
   D. 冰箱在厨房。

4. Which Chinese word means "one"? (1 mark)
   A. 五 wǔ
   B. 一 yī
   C. 二 èr
   D. 四 sì

5. What does 去 (qù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. Church
   C. Mosque
   D. To go

6. What does 礼物 (lǐwù) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Gift
   B. Knife
   C. To play
   D. We

7. What does 杯子 (bēizi) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. To wish
   C. Cup
   D. To give (a gift)

8. Which sentence is correctly punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. 我吃米饭? 你呢。
   B. 我吃米饭、你呢、
   C. 我吃米饭!你呢。
   D. 我吃米饭。你呢?

9. What does 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Biscuits
   B. Drinks
   C. Banana
   D. Water

10. How many strokes does 手 have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 6

11. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my mouth to speak.
   B. I have two eyes.
   C. I use my eyes to see.
   D. I use my ears to hear.

12. Fill the blank: 今天有____。 (Today there is sun.) (1 mark)
   A. 雨
   B. 雪
   C. 太阳
   D. 云

13. Which sentence means "Today it rains"? (1 mark)
   A. 雨下今天。
   B. 今天雨下。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 下今天雨。

14. Which sentence means "The wind is very light."? (1 mark)
   A. 风很小。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 雨很大。
   D. 今天天气很好。

15. Read the pinyin: jīntiān yǒu yún. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today there are clouds.
   B. The sun is very big.
   C. The rain is heavy.
   D. The weather is very good today.

16. What does 也 (yě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Also
   B. Cloud
   C. It rains
   D. Small

17. What does 沙发 (shāfā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Chair
   B. Sofa
   C. Under
   D. Window

18. Fill the blank: 花园在房子____。 (The garden is on the right of the house.) (1 mark)
   A. 下面
   B. 右边
   C. 左边
   D. 里

19. What should a group do first when planning a showcase? (1 mark)
   A. Skip practice
   B. Choose an item and make a plan
   C. Perform at once
   D. Throw away materials

20. What is self-assessment? (1 mark)
   A. Marking a friend
   B. Checking your own work and progress
   C. Ignoring your work
   D. Copying work

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢 (3 marks)

22. Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin. (4 marks)

23. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 水, 没有 and 门. (3 marks)

24. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 午饭 and 快乐. (2 marks)

25. Write five sentences about body parts and what they do, with pinyin. (5 marks)

26. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Wednesday I go to school." (3 marks)

27. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ. (2 marks)

28. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "We cut the cake." (2 marks)

29. Write the first two strokes of 右 and the first two strokes of 左. (3 marks)

30. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Saturday I rest at home." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 在 zài
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

2. A — 卧室
   卧室 is pronounced wòshì and means bedroom.

3. D — 冰箱在厨房。
   冰箱在厨房。 (bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.) means "The fridge is in the kitchen.".

4. B — 一 yī
   一 (yī) means one.

5. D — To go
   去 (qù) means to go.

6. A — Gift
   礼物 (lǐwù) means gift.

7. C — Cup
   杯子 (bēizi) means cup.

8. D — 我吃米饭。你呢?
   A statement ends with 。 and a question with ?.

9. C — Banana
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

10. C — 4
   撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

11. A — I use my mouth to speak.
   wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. is 我用嘴巴说。, which means "I use my mouth to speak.".

12. C — 太阳
   太阳 is the sun.

13. C — 今天下雨。
   今天 + 下雨.

14. A — 风很小。
   风很小。 (fēng hěn xiǎo.) means "The wind is very light.".

15. A — Today there are clouds.
   jīntiān yǒu yún. is 今天有云。, which means "Today there are clouds.".

16. A — Also
   也 (yě) means also.

17. B — Sofa
   沙发 (shāfā) means sofa.

18. B — 右边
   右边 is the right side.

19. B — Choose an item and make a plan
   A plan says who does what.

20. B — Checking your own work and progress
   You look at what you did well and what to improve.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: 水: shuǐ, water. 没有: méiyǒu, there is not. 门: mén, door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: 午饭: wǔfàn, lunch. 快乐: kuàilè, happy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。我用耳朵听。我用嘴巴说。我有两只手。我有两只脚。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng. wǒ yòng zuǐba shuō. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī shǒu. wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence with correct pinyin.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期三去学校。 wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today it rains.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我们切蛋糕。 wǒmen qiē dàngāo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: 右: 撇 then 横. 左: 横 then 撇.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct stroke pair and 1 mark for the difference.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我星期六在家休息。 wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
